test_objectives: Validate all new features in Sprint 12
Ensure regression coverage for critical business workflows
Validate security fixes and vulnerability patches
Test assessment workflows for all supported types (MBTI, Big Five, Enneagram, DISC)
Test data integrity and backup procedures

in_scope: Critical bug fixes from previous sprint

test_cases.title: MBTI Assessment Creation and Completion Workflow
test_cases.description: End-to-end test of MBTI assessment from creation to result generation
preconditions: User is logged in with team leader permissions
Test team exists with assigned members
test_steps: Navigate to Assessments > Create New Assessment
Complete MBTI assessment as test user
expected_results: Results calculated accurately according to MBTI methodology

test_cases.title: Large Team Assessment Performance Test
test_cases.description: Validate assessment performance with large teams (100+ members)
preconditions: Test environment can handle large datasets
test_steps: Assign MBTI assessment to entire team
Simultaneously start assessments for all members
Measure response times for report generation
Validate memory usage remains within limits
expected_results: Response times remain under SLA limits
Memory usage stays within allocated limits
No data corruption or calculation errors
acceptance_criteria: Response time <5 seconds for all operations

test_cases.title: User Login Security and Performance Validation
test_cases.description: Test login functionality with security and performance requirements
preconditions: Test users exist in the system
test_steps: Test valid user login with correct credentials
Test account lockout after multiple failed attempts
Test login with slow network conditions (2G, 3G)
Test concurrent login attempts from multiple locations
expected_results: Invalid login attempts are properly rejected
Account lockout works after threshold attempts
acceptance_criteria: Login success rate >99% for valid credentials
Account lockout occurs after 5 failed attempts
Login response time <3 seconds under normal conditions
Session timeout occurs after configured duration

test_cases.title: Assessment Report Generation and Data Integrity
test_cases.description: Validate comprehensive report generation and data accuracy
preconditions: Assessment data exists for multiple teams
test_steps: Generate Big Five individual assessment report
Validate data accuracy against source assessments
expected_results: Report data matches source assessment data exactly
Export functionality works for all formats
Caching improves performance without data staleness
acceptance_criteria: Report generation time <60 seconds for large datasets
Cached reports update within 5 minutes of data changes
